item.petting.golden_wheat.tooltip: Used to tame animals that find traditional wheat too common.
item.petting.pet_tether.tooltip: Right-click an owned pet to bind it to its current location.
item.petting.teleport_orb.tooltip: Right-click an owned pet to cycle teleportation distance (10-100 blocks).

menu.petting.settings.title: Pet Settings
screen.petting.settings.title: Pet Settings
screen.petting.controls.title: Key Mappings
screen.petting.controls.order_hint: Rules are checked top to bottom.
screen.petting.tooltip.controls: Open the separate key mapping screen.
screen.petting.tooltip.controls_back: Return to the main pet settings screen.
screen.petting.tooltip.controls_save_def: Save these mappings for your future pets.
screen.petting.tooltip.mapping_right: Action performed when you right-click this pet.
screen.petting.tooltip.mapping_shift: Action performed when you shift+right-click this pet.
screen.petting.tooltip.mapping_condition: Optional condition for the action (e.g., SADDLE).
screen.petting.tooltip.mapping_add_rule: Add another rule to this click type.
screen.petting.tooltip.sitstill: When enabled, the pet will stay sitting instead of following or wandering.
screen.petting.tooltip.waiting: Waiting prevents the pet from wandering but keeps it ready to obey owner commands.
screen.petting.tooltip.attack_owner_atta: If enabled, the pet will attack targets its owner attacks.
If enabled, the pet defends its owner when the owner is attacked.
screen.petting.tooltip.attack_self_attac: If enabled, the pet retaliates when it is attacked.
screen.petting.tooltip.damage_owner: Allow the pet to damage its owner (use with caution).
screen.petting.tooltip.ignore_whistle: If true, the pet will ignore global whistle/Goat Horn commands.
screen.petting.tooltip.followdistance: How many blocks away before the pet follows the owner.
screen.petting.tooltip.teleportdistance: Distance threshold for teleporting to the owner.
